<?php
class Token97A { function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; } }
class Origin97A {
    function capture() {
        return function (&$token) {
            static $counter = 0; $counter = $counter + 1;
            echo 'BODY|', $counter, '|';
            try { yield $counter; }
            finally { echo 'FIN|', $counter, '|'; }
        };
    }
    function __destruct() { echo 'OLD|'; }
}
class Active97A { function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; } }
function NewToken97A() { global $weakToken; $token = new Token97A(); $weakToken = WeakReference::create($token); return $token; }
function Warn97A($severity, $message) {
    global $warningCount;
    echo 'WARN|'; $warningCount = $warningCount + 1;
    Fiber::suspend('WARN'); echo 'WARN-END|'; return true;
}
function Run97A() {
    global $source, $maker, $g;
    echo 'CALL|'; $g = $source->call($maker, NewToken97A()); echo 'CREATED|';
}
$old = new Origin97A(); $weakOld = WeakReference::create($old);
$source = $old->capture(); $weakSource = WeakReference::create($source); unset($old);
$slot = null; $seed = $source($slot); echo 'SEED|', $seed->current(), '|'; unset($seed);
$warningCount = 0; set_error_handler('Warn97A');
$maker = new Active97A(); $weakMaker = WeakReference::create($maker); $g = null;
$fiber = new Fiber('Run97A');
echo 'START|', $fiber->start() === 'WARN', '|';
echo 'PARK|', $weakSource->get() instanceof Closure, '|', $weakOld->get() instanceof Origin97A, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof Active97A, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token97A, '|';
$slot = null; $probe = $source($slot); echo 'PROBE|', $probe->current(), '|'; unset($probe);
$source = null; $maker = null;
echo 'HELD|', $weakSource->get() instanceof Closure, '|', $weakOld->get() instanceof Origin97A, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof Active97A, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token97A, '|';
echo 'RESUME|'; $fiber->resume(); restore_error_handler(); unset($fiber);
echo 'FRESH|', $warningCount === 1, '|', $weakSource->get() === null, '|', $weakOld->get() === null, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof Active97A, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token97A, '|';
echo 'VALUE|', $g->current(), '|'; $g->next();
echo 'DONE|', $g->getReturn() === null, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof Active97A, '|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|';
unset($g); echo 'DROP|', $weakMaker->get() === null, '|E';
